# Step Right parser fixtures

Files prefixed with `synthetic-` were written from the source playbook on
2026-09-13. They are contract examples, not archived source evidence. The
example people are invented. The invented `2.1` callback tests that unverified
sub-values remain uninterpreted; it does not establish that the source prints
this value.

Files prefixed with `real-` are byte-exact archived response bodies. Their
URLs, capture times, hashes, interpretation state, and source receipts are in
`real-provenance-20260917.json`. The 2015 event body remains a parser fixture;
it does not admit the source kind or accept a historical year.

Retained archive discovery evidence is
`research/verification/2026-09-11/cdx_steprightsolutions_html_all.json`.
The sibling `wayback_id_steprt_events_index.hdr` and
`wayback_id_steprt_round_507.hdr` / `508.hdr` files retain response headers.
These fixtures do not establish coverage across real event years.
